verdict.rationale: Docs give multiple documented one-liner install paths ($skill-installer <name>, /plugins marketplace browser, codex plugin marketplace add) and a real hands-on probe (npx skills add ... -a codex) confirms a skill installs into .agents/skills with valid SKILL.md frontmatter, which docs say Codex scans automatically from cwd up to repo root — meaning it becomes active without extra config. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that the skill is available in the very next session without any reload/restart step, and broader independent corroboration beyond the single hands-on probe.
